plugins.description: Deque's accessibility toolkit for coding agents. Get accessible UI effortlessly - your agent builds, tests, and remediates accessibility in the loop, so it's never a separate, manual chore. Currently powers the Axe MCP Server scan -> remediate -> verify workflow, including keyboard guided tests; expanding over time.
